minutes.headline: Committee set a meeting schedule to finish design and cost estimate by end of January for a spring funding article
minutes.summary: The TCP building design committee heard the design team's plan for the next design development phase and a calendar of meetings leading to a consolidated report and preliminary cost estimate. They tentatively set meetings for Dec 14 and Dec 17 at 5:30, with committee-only working sessions, and aim for a funding article at spring town meeting. They discussed sharing information on community Facebook pages and approved three sets of prior minutes.

what_happened.line: The TCP Building Design Committee set a tentative schedule to finish design and a preliminary cost estimate by the end of January.
Whole-committee meetings were set for Monday Dec 14 and Thursday Dec 17 at 5:30, with the second possibly cancelled if not needed.
The design team described the next phase: gathering information for construction and soft cost estimates, pricing alternates, and setting inflation and furniture assumptions.
The stated goal is a funding article at spring town meeting, with the funding method and vote type still to be worked out with the town manager.
One member will share the presentation link on town Facebook groups, information only; no votes were taken at the meeting.

why_it_matters: The January cost estimate is the figure a spring town meeting funding article would likely rest on, so it sets what residents may be asked to vote on and, depending on the funding method, what could reach a tax bill.
The funding method and vote type are not yet decided, and those choices determine whether the cost is borrowed or paid another way.
